meta.pack_name: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) — MetriScan starter pack
meta.statute: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 as amended
meta.WARNING: Rule text, rule numbers and every numeric threshold below marked UNVERIFIED are placeholders derived from the problem statement's own list of mandatory declarations. They are NOT a legal source. Before any demo or deployment, open the current consolidated Rules on consumeraffairs.gov.in plus the amending gazette notifications, replace each definition, put the G.S.R. number in source_reference, and set verification_status to VERIFIED. The application blocks finalisation while UNVERIFIED versions are in force unless METRISCAN_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_RULES is set.
amendments_to_check: G.S.R. 128(E) dated 13 February 2026 — inserted Rule 6(10A), country-of-origin filter for e-commerce
Second Amendment Rules 2026 dated 27 April 2026 — substituted Rule 6(10A), commencement moved to 1 July 2027
Third Amendment Rules 2026, G.S.R. 418(E) dated 29 May 2026 — importer labelling at AEO bonded warehouses, director accountability, annual online updates
Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2026 dated 8 April 2026 — decriminalisation; affects the severity model, not the declarations

rules.title: Name of the commodity
rules.description: The package must declare the name of the commodity contained in it.

versions.source_reference: VERIFY against the mandatory-declarations rule in the current consolidated LMPC Rules, 2011.

rules.title: Name and address of the manufacturer, packer or importer
rules.description: The package must declare the name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer.

versions.source_reference: VERIFY against the mandatory-declarations rule in the current consolidated LMPC Rules, 2011.

rules.title: Manufacturer declaration includes a complete address
rules.description: A name on its own does not satisfy the requirement; a complete address must accompany it.

versions.source_reference: VERIFY what constitutes a complete address under the current Rules.

messages.has_address: no address text was detected after the manufacturer name

rules.title: Net quantity
rules.description: The package must declare the net quantity in standard units of weight, measure or number.

versions.source_reference: VERIFY against the net-quantity declaration rule in the current consolidated LMPC Rules, 2011.

rules.title: Net quantity is declared in standard units
rules.description: Net quantity must be expressed in SI units of mass or volume, or in number.

versions.source_reference: VERIFY the permitted units and abbreviations in the current Rules and the SI-unit advisory.

rules.title: Net quantity appears on the principal display panel
rules.description: The net quantity declaration must appear on the principal display panel of the package.

versions.source_reference: VERIFY the placement requirement and the definition of principal display panel in the current Rules.

rules.title: Net quantity is printed at the minimum permitted character height
rules.description: Numerals and letters in the net quantity declaration must meet a minimum height determined by the area of the principal display panel.

versions.source_reference: PLACEHOLDER TABLE — replace every band below with the height table in the current consolidated Rules before use.

rules.title: Retail sale price (MRP)
rules.description: The package must declare the maximum retail price at which the commodity may be sold.

versions.source_reference: VERIFY against the retail sale price declaration rule in the current consolidated LMPC Rules, 2011.

rules.title: MRP is declared as inclusive of all taxes
rules.description: The retail sale price must be declared in the prescribed form indicating that it is inclusive of all taxes.

versions.source_reference: VERIFY the prescribed form of the retail sale price declaration in the current Rules.

messages.inclusive_of_taxes: the wording 'inclusive of all taxes' was not detected near the price

rules.title: MRP is printed at the minimum permitted character height
rules.description: Numerals in the retail sale price declaration must meet the prescribed minimum height.

versions.source_reference: PLACEHOLDER TABLE — replace with the height table in the current consolidated Rules before use.

rules.title: Month and year of manufacture, packing or import
rules.description: The package must declare the month and year in which the commodity was manufactured, packed or imported.

versions.source_reference: VERIFY against the date-of-manufacture declaration rule in the current consolidated LMPC Rules, 2011.

rules.title: Consumer care details
rules.description: The package must carry the name, address, telephone number or email address of the person who can be contacted with consumer complaints.

versions.source_reference: VERIFY against the consumer-care declaration rule in the current consolidated LMPC Rules, 2011.

rules.title: Country of origin for imported packages
rules.description: An imported package must declare the country of origin of the commodity.

versions.source_reference: VERIFY against the country-of-origin declaration rule for imported packages.

rules.title: E-commerce listings of imported products carry a country-of-origin filter
rules.description: Rule 6(10A) requires an e-commerce entity offering an imported product for sale to provide the listing with a searchable and sortable filter specifying the country of origin. Included here as a worked example of rule versioning: the sub-rule was inserted with one commencement date and then substituted with a later one.

versions.source_reference: G.S.R. 128(E) dated 13 February 2026, inserting Rule 6(10A); notified commencement 1 July 2026. Confirm the gazette text directly.
Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Second Amendment Rules, 2026 dated 27 April 2026, substituting Rule 6(10A) with effect from 1 July 2027. Confirm the gazette text directly.

rules.title: Best-before date follows the date of manufacture
rules.description: Cross-field sanity check for a misleading or misprinted date pair.

versions.source_reference: Internal consistency check, not a statutory requirement. Reported as a data-quality finding.

rules.title: Unit sale price is consistent with the declared MRP and net quantity
rules.description: Detects a misleading unit price that does not follow from the declared MRP and quantity.

versions.source_reference: Internal arithmetic consistency check between declared values.

rules.title: A single MRP value appears across all submitted images
rules.description: Two different retail prices printed on one package is a misleading declaration.

versions.source_reference: Internal consistency check across the images of one inspection.
